scope.comparison_unit: every OpenAPI path and HTTP operation

conclusion.reason: The selection now covers the full 162-path/172-operation MVP surface. FastAPI already executes the real handlers and generates the request, response and OpenAPI contracts. Bare Flask can mirror all routes, but the 172 business handlers plus validation and documentation contracts would still require an explicit port.
conclusion.limitation: The Flask mirror is a routing and migration-effort comparison, not a claim that the full Ontology Dashboard business implementation exists twice.
